concerns.text: The baseline weighted‑average elemental‑CTE model is constructed using elemental CTE values retrieved from the Materials Project (Phase 4). However, the alloy CTE targets are also sourced (in part) from the Materials Project DFT data. This creates a validation target that is not independent of the predictor data, risking a circular or tautological comparison where the baseline and the model are derived from the same underlying computational source. Moreover, the specification (SC‑001) states the baseline should use NIST Thermophysical Properties, but the plan uses MP, violating the intended independent reference.
